principle_violations.reason: The `VolumeCalculator` class currently inherits from `AreaCalculator` and is responsible for calculating volumes, but the method `sum` is improperly attempting to calculate area instead of volume, which violates its responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a separate method for calculating volume based on the shape type that extends the functionality of the existing Shape interface.

principle_violations.reason: The `AreaCalculator`'s `sum` method assumes that all shapes can be treated the same way. Since not all shapes will support a volume calculation, this violates the Liskov Substitution Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the Shape interface to include a `volume` method and ensure only appropriate shapes implement the method.

principle_violations.reason: The `AreaCalculator` and `VolumeCalculator` will require modification if new shape types (that implement area or volume) are added. This violates the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define an abstract base class for shape calculations that can be extended for additional shape types without modifying the existing code.

overall_feedback: 3 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
